name: Four Seasons Resort Chiang Mai
positioning: A Lanna-style resort of pavilions and pool villas set among rice terraces in the Mae Rim Valley near Chiang Mai
best_for: Travelers who want a rice-terrace setting with hands-on activities such as rice planting and buffalo bathing
Families and groups wanting private residences

facts.text: The resort has 98 rooms in total.
The resort is set in 13 hectares of landscaped gardens and rice terraces.
The resort has a working rice farm with its own family of water buffalo.
The Wara Cheewa Spa has 7 treatment rooms.
The resort has two infinity-edge pools overlooking the rice terrace.
The resort's restaurants include KHAO by Four Seasons, which serves Pan-Thai cuisine.
North by Four Seasons is a grill restaurant cooking on open flame.
Rim Tai Kitchen is the resort's restaurant and cooking studio, designed by Bill Bensley.

highlights.text: The design aesthetic is Lanna Kingdom style.
The resort layout is reminiscent of a Thai village, with pavilions surrounding a working rice farm.
Guests can scrub down a friendly buffalo at the Buffalo Barn.
The Rice Barn offers private breakfast or dinner amid emerald green paddies.

considerations.text: The resort is 30 minutes from downtown Chiang Mai.
Chiang Mai International Airport is 35 km from the resort.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to reach Chiang Mai city center.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
